newsitem.title: JAPAN: Aisin Seiki sees 96/97 sales exceeding forecast.
newsitem.headline: Aisin Seiki sees 96/97 sales exceeding forecast.

text.p: Japanese auto parts maker Aisin Seiki Co Ltd said on Thursday that it expects sales in the 1996/97 business year to exceed its previous forecast of 492 billion yen despite a fire at one of its plant in February.
The fire which broke out at a company plant on February 1 halted output of some brake parts supplied to Toyota Motor Corp.
The company said in a statement that it was difficult to predict its profit for the current business year as it was still studying the impact of the fire.
Aisin Seiki also said it would leave unchanged its dividend forecast for 1996/97.
The company also said it cut salaries for some of its top executives and would not pay any bonuses for the current business year to its board members.
